messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD#32178 fired — High 5xx rate on inference-gateway-prod (eu-west1). 5m error-rate 8.7% (alert threshold 5%). Affected route: POST /v1/runtime/generate. Spike started ~2026-03-15T02:12Z. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/g/pg/32178

tara: acked in PD, taking lead. I'm +1 on the channel. any quick wins we can try before paging infra?

junaid: seeing a lot of 502/524 mix in gateway logs, but origin response times are fine for most. pattern: failures concentrated to requests with large prompt_size > 120k chars.

junaid: tail logs snippet:```
[02:13:05] upstream=10.40.2.11:5042 conn_reset POST /v1/runtime/generate id=ffc3
[02:13:06] upstream=10.40.2.15:5042 524 timeout reading response id=ffc4
[02:13:06] prompt_size=132421 tokens=23 model_variant=redwood-3-large
```

ops-bot: Autoscaler: scaled inference-gateway-svc +4 pods at 02:14Z due to CPU spike. New desired=12.

sre-oncall: thanks. two observations: (1) traffic fanout is unbalanced — route table shows 82% of POST /v1/runtime/generate routed to eu-west1-a35 pool (should be ~33%). (2) retry storms from client retries are amplifying load for large payloads.

sre-oncall: check router dump: `rdsctl dump routes --service inference-gateway --env prod --region eu-west1`

tara: on it. pulling current route table...

tara: route dump shows sticky affinity to a3 nodes from earlier canary: `route_rule: header:x-canary => eu-west1-a35` — canary flag may be matching too broadly.

junaid: can we flip canary flag off as mitigation? that'd rebalance quickly. risk: small percentage of canary-specific perf tweaks will be lost.

sre-oncall: do it. also temporarily increase upstream timeout to avoid 524s triggering retries: `kubectl patch deployment inference-gateway -n prod --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"gateway","env":[{"name":"UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS","value":"120000"}]}]}}}}'`

ops-bot: command queued by tara: disable-canary-route 

incident-bot: Action logged: disable-canary-route invoked by tara at 02:16:12Z.

tara: flipped canary routing off at 02:16:20Z. rebalancing now.

junaid: I'm also patching nginx upstream keepalive to reduce conn resets: `kubectl exec -it gateway-pod -- sed -i "s/keepalive_timeout 10;/keepalive_timeout 30;/" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && nginx -s reload`

maya: jumping in for next hour to monitor, I'm on-call. will watch PD and SLO dashboards. @sre-oncall please put a short TL;DR in incident doc once stable.

sre-oncall: initial impact estimate: ~6% of total requests in last 15m saw 5xx; customer-visible failures concentrated to large-payload endpoints (batch imports, long-context evals). No major merchant-wide outages reported yet.

ops-bot: Traffic rebalance started at 02:17:30Z. shard distribution now eu-west1-a35: 36%, eu-west1-b12: 33%, eu-west1-c07: 31%. Error-rate dropping to 2.1% (5m).

junaid: after fixes, seeing fewer connection resets; K/V cache miss-rate spiked earlier and is settling after rebalancing. still seeing a handful of 524s for the largest requests >200k chars.

tara: mitigation summary: disabled canary routing, bumped upstream timeout, tweaked keepalive. no rollback required. continuing to monitor for 30m.

maya: FYI I've notified CS about limited impact to batch imports; asked them to message top 10 paying customers if they surface issues.

sre-oncall: creating incident doc: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/PD-32178 with timeline + action items: follow-ups: (1) root cause analysis on why canary header match was broad, (2) add autoscaling rule for large-payload surge, (3) make threshold-based temporary timeout bump safer.

incident-bot: PD#32178 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (error-rate <= alert threshold). Monitoring for 30m. On-call: maya.

maya: tagging handoff: @junaid you're primary RCA lead, tara please run the postmortem checklist, I'll keep watch until 03:00Z then hand to night SRE. :thumbsup:
